en-US.title: Control Your PC
en-US.subtitle: Remote control, stay signed in
en-US.promoText: Remote control for your Mac that never makes you log in again. Switch apps, lock your phone, come back: it reconnects on its own. Private over your own network.
en-US.description:
Remote control for your Mac that keeps you signed in. Tired of logging in again every time you switch apps? Control Your PC reconnects on its own: switch to another app, lock your phone, come back an hour later, and you are right where you left off. No password prompt, no starting over. You stay signed in until you choose to close the session.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Remote control of your Mac from anywhere: see the screen, move the pointer, click and type
• Pinch to zoom and pan with two fingers
• Trackpad mode: move the pointer, tap to click, tap with two fingers to right-click, press and drag, and scroll with two fingers
• A text box: type or paste a whole command or paragraph and send it to your Mac in one go
• Esc, Tab, Control, Option, Command and arrow keys on a toolbar

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your phone connects straight to your Mac over your own private Tailscale network. There is no cloud service in the middle, no account with us, no ads and no tracking. We never see your screen or your keystrokes.

BEFORE YOU START
Control Your PC needs a free program on your Mac, and a free Tailscale account on your Mac and your phone. Setup takes about five minutes: download the Mac program from the website linked on this page, run the installer, and open the address it shows. Windows support is planned.

A NOTE ON "ALWAYS CONNECTED"
iOS pauses apps that are in the background, so no app can hold a live screen while it is hidden. Control Your PC reconnects the moment you return, usually within a second or two, and your Mac session (your open apps and windows) is never touched.

SUBSCRIPTION
Control Your PC is free to download. Start with a 3-day free trial, then $9.99 per year. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase and renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID settings.
